# Scenario Engineering Checklist: Chatter and Model-Enabled Rivet Scenarios

**Purpose**: Review whether requirements completely define typed Chatter inference, MCP/model composition, engineering invariants, truthful advisory output, and provider-neutral evidence.
**Created**: 2026-08-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command as a formal PR-review requirements gate. It evaluates the writing, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all 37 input features required to have stable order, engineering meaning, unit, finite numeric type, origin classification, contract range, and population range? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 Are result requirements complete for identity/order, state, score, threshold, margin, calibration, applicability, warnings, limitations, and exact model evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are CAD context, simulated CAM candidates, model evaluation, discrete comparison, invariants, advisory report, evidence, and cleanup all required scenario stages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019–FR-025]
- [x] CHK004 Are provider evidence requirements complete for both MCP and engineering-model capability kinds without conflating their identities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-027]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the score described consistently as an uncalibrated model output, with every prohibited probability/confidence/certification interpretation explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012–FR-015]
- [x] CHK006 Is the exact threshold equality rule and near-threshold review band defined so a boundary result has one deterministic interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Serving format and adapter]
- [x] CHK007 Is “compare only caller-supplied discrete candidates” precise enough to exclude interpolation, synthesis, continuous optimization, and machine-setting prescription? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK008 Is “selected for human review” clearly distinguished from safe, recommended, certified, or authorized for machining? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, §FR-037]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are model capability discovery/binding/call/cancel/audit requirements consistent with the existing single Wright gateway authority boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §FR-030, §FR-033]
- [x] CHK010 Are scenario Tier-1 environment requirements consistent with the use of a real local package while keeping source training and private qualification outside normal gates? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §FR-035–FR-036, §SC-003, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK011 Are candidate correlation requirements consistent from CAM receipt through model output, report, child-call evidence, and reproduction comparison? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023–FR-028]
- [x] CHK012 Are model applicability and non-model invariant requirements jointly sufficient to prevent an ineligible candidate from being preferred? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-016, §FR-025]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are the minimum capability/provider count, candidate count, duration, environment, and invariant outcomes objectively measurable for the Tier-1 scenario? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK014 Are deterministic material results separated from variable timing/resource/trace observations with clear comparison rules? [Measurability, Spec §FR-028, §NFR-004, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK015 Can every prohibited executable-machine or physical-actuation outcome be detected from a closed requirement rather than subjective review? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026, §FR-037, §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are primary, no-eligible-candidate, duplicate-label, threshold-equality, out-of-population, failed-invariant, malformed-CAM, stale-binding, and model-failure flows all specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014–FR-016, §FR-031–FR-032]
- [x] CHK017 Are cancellation races before load, during inference, after partial result, during report creation, and during cleanup addressed with one terminal-state rule? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-030–FR-032]
- [x] CHK018 Are exact reproduction and every material-difference scenario specified for package, runtime, vector, MCP, workflow, fixture, input, policy, and evidence drift? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028, User Story 5]

## Extension and Boundary Quality

- [x] CHK019 Are extension requirements written in provider-neutral terms and explicit about collision handling, versioning, and prohibited model-ID branches? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, §SC-011]
- [x] CHK020 Are the boundaries between model inference, scenario assertions, advisory selection, and any future CAM/machine integration documented so Gate E cannot be crossed implicitly? [Boundary, Spec §FR-015–FR-016, §FR-037, Out of Scope]
